column1: # Where apps come from (Phase 3.4). Curated; reviewed in pull requests.
# kind: store = an app store; installer = the system's "open an APK file" installer; shell = adb.
# "must be a system app": the store comes preinstalled, so a non-system app using that package name is a fake
# (e.g. a sideloaded app squatting com.android.vending on a phone without Google Play).
